records.text: An unidentified hospital parking-lot witness recalled a white-hatted man exiting the SUV’s rear hatch, a bald driver getting out, and another occupant being placed on a wheeled hospital bed; the witness did not identify these people by name.
records.speaker: Hospital parking-lot witness in episode 385 (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: And when they pulled in here, some dude gets out in the back, some dudes in the back like of the SUV. ... It has like a white hat on and he ... Gets out from the, I don't know what he's doing in the back. He's in, no, not like in the back seat, he's in the back back. ... Like the, the hatch of the SUV opens up. ... Dude gets out, ... Driver gets out, he's bald headed dude. ... And then they're met by some people right here. ... Then they threw, well, whoever's in the backseat, like on a, what's that table they come, they throw your ass on and then wheel you in.
